--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py

 from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
 from backend.data.crud import get_contact_by_id, update_contact
 from backend.data.contact_schemas import ContactSchema
@@ -10,6 +11,7 @@ class ContactManager:
     def __init__(self, db_session):
         self.db = db_session
         self.schema = ContactSchema()
+        self._residence_pattern = re.compile(r'^wohnt\s+in\s+', re.IGNORECASE)
 
     def _is_residence_fact(self, detail: str) -> bool:
         """Check if a personal detail string is a residence-style fact."""
-        return False
+        return bool(self._residence_pattern.match(detail.strip()))
 
     def _extract_residence(self, detail: str) -> Optional[str]:
         """Extract the location part from a residence fact."""
-        return None
+        match = self._residence_pattern.match(detail.strip())
+        if match:
+            return detail.strip()[match.end():].strip()
+        return None
 
     def _normalize_contact(self, contact: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         """Normalize a contact dict: move residence facts from personal_details to address."""
         contact = dict(contact)
         personal_details = contact.get('personal_details', [])
         if not isinstance(personal_details, list):
             personal_details = []
         address = contact.get('address', '')
         if not isinstance(address, str):
             address = ''
         new_personal_details = []
         for detail in personal_details:
             if self._is_residence_fact(detail):
                 residence = self._extract_residence(detail)
                 if residence:
                     if address:
                         address = f"{address}, {residence}"
                     else:
                         address = residence
             else:
                 new_personal_details.append(detail)
         contact['personal_details'] = new_personal_details
         contact['address'] = address
         return contact
 
     def update_contact(self, contact_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         """Update a contact, normalizing residence facts."""
         existing = get_contact_by_id(self.db, contact_id)
         if not existing:
             raise ValueError(f"Contact {contact_id} not found")
         merged = {**existing, **updates}
         merged = self._normalize_contact(merged)
         return update_contact(self.db, contact_id, merged)
 
     def get_contact(self, contact_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         """Get a contact, normalizing on read."""
         contact = get_contact_by_id(self.db, contact_id)
         if contact:
             contact = self._normalize_contact(contact)
         return contact
 
     def get_all_contacts(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
         """Get all contacts, normalizing each on read."""
         contacts = get_contact_by_id(self.db, None)  # assume returns all
         if not contacts:
             return []
         return [self._normalize_contact(c) for c in contacts]
